author: Zephyr I
title: Baseline Re-run: Default CNN + Policy Gradient
abstract: We replicate the system’s DefaultResidualCNN with the default policy-gradient training to produce our own baseline evaluation ID for fair comparison in our paper. No architectural or algorithmic changes.
